an11.17:1.1: ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ
an11.17:1.3: idha bhikkhave gopālako na rūpaññū hoti na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti na titthaṃ jānāti na pītaṃ jānāti na vīthiṃ jānāti na gocarakusalo hoti anavasesadohī hoti ye te usabhā gopitaro goparināyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti
an11.17:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ evameva
an11.17:2.1: kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ
an11.17:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti na titthaṃ jānāti na pītaṃ jānāti na vithiṃ jānāti na gocarakusalo hoti anavasesadohī hoti ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṃghaparināyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti
an11.17:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti
an11.17:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ cattāri ca mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāyarūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.17:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti.
an11.17:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti
an11.17:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kammalakkhaṇo bālo kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍitoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.17:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
an11.17:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti
an11.17:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ adhivāseti na pajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ … uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ …
an11.17:5.3: uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme adhivāseti na pajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti
an11.17:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.
an11.17:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti
an11.17:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī
an11.17:6.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an11.17:6.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī
an11.17:6.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an11.17:6.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.
an11.17:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti
an11.17:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti
an11.17:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.
an11.17:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti
an11.17:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchati na paripañhati
an11.17:8.3: idaṃ bhante kathaṃ imassa ko atthoti
an11.17:8.4: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva na vivaranti anuttānīkatañca na uttānīkaronti anekavihitesu kaṅkhaṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na paṭivinodenti
an11.17:8.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti.
an11.17:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti
an11.17:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na labhati atthavedaṃ na labhati dhammavedaṃ na labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.17:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pītaṃ na jānāti.
an11.17:10.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti
an11.17:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.17:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti.
an11.17:11.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti
an11.17:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.17:11.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti.
an11.17:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena tatra bhikkhave bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya
an11.17:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti.
an11.17:13.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṃghapitaro saṃghaparināyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti
an11.17:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṃghapitaro saṃghaparināyakā tesu na mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvīceva raho ca na mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ … na mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvīceva raho ca
an11.17:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṃghapitaro saṃghaparināyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti
